gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Gliomas (DIPG); Progressive DIPG; Refractory DIPG; Recurrent DIPG; H3K27-altered High Grade Glioma
ACT001 for the Treatment of Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Gliomas and H3K27-altered High Grade Gliomas

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a Phase II open-label study to investigate the safety and efficacy of ACT001 in patients with DIPG and H3K27-altered HGG.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients will be enrolled on either Cohort A for newly diagnosed DIPG or on Cohort B \[ENROLLMENT PAUSED\] for those with progressive / refractory DIPG or progressive / recurrent / refractory H3K27-altered HGG.

role_evidence.quote: PO BID at 875 mg/m2 for 28 days
Each cohort will receive ACT001 at 875 mg/m2 orally BID for 28 days (1 cycle of treatment), up to a maximum dose of 1700 mg BID.

source_quote.quote: Patients with progressive/recurrent DIPG or H3K27-altered HGG OR refractory disease

coder_notes: Population is DIPG and H3K27-altered high-grade glioma (ages 12 months to 39 years); glioblastoma is not named anywhere, so not_glioblastoma. Cohort A starts ACT001 after completion of radiotherapy, so regimen is monotherapy. H3K27 alteration defines the non-DIPG part of Cohort B (DIPG patients need no biopsy); ACT001 has no stated H3K27-directed mechanism.
